title: Accuracy of Uniform Inference on Fine Grid Points
abstract: arXiv:2512.18627v2 Announce Type: replace-cross  Abstract: Uniform confidence bands are widely used in empirical analysis for uncertainty qualification of nonparametric inference of unknown functions. A variety of simple implementation methods, including multiplier bootstrap, have been proposed and theoretically justified. However, an implementation over a literally continuous index set is generally computationally infeasible, and practitioners therefore compute the critical value by evaluating the statistic on a finite evaluation grid. This paper quantifies the effect of this discretization on coverage accuracy and consider how fine the evaluation grid must be for a multiplier bootstrap procedure over finite grid points to deliver valid uniform confidence bands. Specifically, we first illustrate that coarse grids can invalidate uniform inference. translated_title: 细网格点上均匀推断的精度
translated_abstract: 均匀置信带在实证分析中被广泛用于对未知函数的非参数推断进行不确定性量化。目前已有多种简单的实现方法（包括乘数自助法）被提出并得到了理论上的证明。然而，在字面意义上的连续指标集上进行实现通常在计算上是不可行的，因此实践者通过在有限的评估网格上计算统计量来获得临界值。本文量化了这种离散化对覆盖精度的影响，并研究了评估网格需要达到何种精细程度，才能使基于有限网格点的乘数自助法程序提供有效的均匀置信带。具体而言，我们首先说明了粗糙的网格可能会使均匀推断失效。对于基于核平滑的非参数估计量，我们建立了在何种条件下均匀覆盖率会收敛到零，即使……
tldr: 本文量化了均匀置信带推断中有限网格离散化对覆盖精度的影响，证明粗糙网格可能导致均匀推断失效，并给出了使基于有限网格点的乘数自助法产生有效均匀置信带所需的网格精细度条件。
en_tdlr: This paper quantifies the effect of discretization on the coverage accuracy of uniform confidence bands, showing that coarse grids can invalidate uniform inference and establishing how fine the evaluation grid must be for the multiplier bootstrap over finite grid points to deliver valid uniform confidence bands.
